name: hud_duel_seawall_tip
description: The duel bar explains the Seawall (playtest halv s1, P4: 'Seawall 0 (F)', later 'F 15 s', with no tooltip; the persona did not know what it stops, its reach, how long it lasts, how it charges or what the seconds count down to). On Undertow's own rules against the caretaker, hovering my Seawall (or its column's caption) shows a plate under the bar: 'Seawall (F)', what a burst does in the rules' numbers (within 3 tiles of the Holdfast, stunned 2 s, 25% of its health, a boss 8% and slowed 50%), how it charges (a charge every 4 lives lost, at most 2) and how long after a burst the next may come (15 s), then where it stands: no charge yet and how many lives earn one, a charge ready, and after a burst what the seconds beside F count down to. The rival's Seawall says its charges. The words follow the records as they move.

steps.msg: hovering my Seawall shows its plate

steps.assert: Game.seawall_rule_text() == 'F, during a wave: surf bursts up round your Holdfast, and every creep within 3 tiles of it is stunned for 2 s and loses 25% of its health; a boss loses 8% and is slowed 50% instead. A charge for every 4 lives you lose, at most 2; after a burst the next may come 15 s later.'
steps.msg: what a burst does, how it charges and its wait, in the rules' numbers

steps.assert: node('DuelBar').tip_shown()[1] == Game.seawall_rule_text() + '\nNo charge yet. 4 more lives lost earn one.'
steps.msg: and where mine stands: no charge yet, four lives to the first

steps.assert: tip.position.y >= bar.end.y and tip.end.x <= bar.end.x + 1 and tip.end.y < 400
steps.msg: hung under the bar, its right edge with the bar's

steps.assert: node('DuelBar').tip_shown()[1].ends_with('No charge yet. 1 more life lost earns one.')
node('DuelBar').tip_shown()[1].ends_with('1 charge ready. 4 more lives lost earn another.')
node('DuelBar').tip_shown() == ['Your rival\'s Seawall', 'It bursts round your rival\'s Holdfast as yours does round yours. No charge.']

steps.msg: the column's caption explains mine too

steps.assert: node('DuelBar').tip_shown()[1].contains('No charge now. The seconds beside F count down to when the next may burst: 15 s.') or node('DuelBar').tip_shown()[1].contains('No charge now. The seconds beside F count down to when the next may burst: 14 s.')
steps.msg: after a burst it says what the seconds beside F count down to

steps.assert: node('DuelBar').lines()[0].ends_with(' · ready in 15 s') or node('DuelBar').lines()[0].ends_with(' · ready in 14 s')
steps.msg: the very seconds the bar shows
